text: When their cars fail on a lonely rural road, a group of young friends end up at Slausen's Lost Oasis, a roadside museum fading since the new freeway took its trade. Its lonely owner warns them away from the nearby house, where [waxwork figures turn and cackle|images|dolls, masks and likenesses] and a masked stranger [moves objects without a touch|threat|powers of the mind]. One by one the friends vanish, and Eileen is found [turned into a mannequin|rules|the body changes].
